Why is Lord Ganesha worshipped first? 🙏

In the Shiva Purana, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva themselves declare it: he shall be worshipped first, and they after him. He is the remover of all obstacles.

Told from the Shiva Purana, Rudra Samhita, Kumara Khanda, chapter 18.

What do you offer Ganesha first in your home puja?

youtube_description:
After his elephant head, Mata Parvati, Lord Shiva and the gods bless Ganesha. Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva declare that he shall be worshipped first, as the remover of all obstacles. Told as cute 3D clay animation, from the Shiva Purana.

Sources:
